evidence: Koreas five regional banks (Gyeongnam, Gwangju, Busan, Jeonbuk, Jeju) posted an average delinquency rate of 1.33% at end-Q2 2026, the highest since FSS records began in 2008 (17-year high) — more than 3x the 0.39% average at the five nationwide banks (KB, Shinhan, Hana, Woori, NH). source: KOSIS DT_1J22001 — Aug 2026 CPI, re-verified by SeoulMarkets
evidence: Korea headline CPI +3.09% YoY Aug 2026 (KOSIS raw index 116.45->120.05), but the swing is concentrated almost entirely in one sub-item: mobile phone fee +26.74% YoY (base effect from a 2025 discount promotion), while landline/internet fees were flat (+0.07%/0.00%). Finance Ministry estimated ex-base-effect CPI at ~2.5%. Directionally neutral — headline beat is a known technical base effect, not a broad-based inflation surprise.
